layout.arrangement: Title centered at top inside a thin red-bordered frame; slide number '47' in a yellow circle at top-right corner. Below the title, two side-by-side scatter-plot panels, each with red L-shaped axes (vertical axis on left, horizontal axis on bottom with arrowheads). Left panel captioned 'Data of Three Classes', right panel captioned 'No Unique Nearest Neighbor'.

regions.name: title bar
regions.content: Title text with 'Nearest Neighbors' in red and '(NN) Equal Distance' in blue; yellow circled '47' at far right

regions.name: left plot
regions.content: Scatter plot with three clusters of colored dots (green upper-left, cyan upper-right, tan/beige bottom-center), red axes, caption below

regions.name: right plot
regions.content: Same three clusters plus a large red query point at center with thin red lines radiating to all data points; two yellow-highlighted points (one green, one tan) circled with dashed red rings at equal distance; caption below

layout.hierarchy: Title dominates (large bold red/blue text), then the two plot panels of equal visual weight, then red captions beneath each plot, then the small yellow slide-number badge.

visual_elements.description: Left scatter plot: red L-shaped axes with arrowheads (no tick labels). Three clusters of filled circles with dark outlines: ~10 green dots in upper-left diagonal cluster, ~9 cyan dots in upper-right cluster, ~6 tan/beige dots in bottom-center cluster. Caption 'Data of Three Classes' in red below.

Right scatter plot: same three clusters, plus one large red filled circle (query point) near center. Thin light-red/pink lines connect the red point to every data point, each ending in a small red arrowhead at the data point. Two points are highlighted with yellow fill and dashed red circles: one green point to the left of the red point and one tan point below-right of it, illustrating equal distance. Caption 'No Unique Nearest Neighbor' in red below.
Yellow circle badge containing black number '47' at top-right corner of the frame

imagery: No photographs; only hand-drawn-style scatter plots with colored dots, a red query point, radiating connector lines with arrowheads, and two dashed-circle highlights.
typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout. Title is large and bold: 'Nearest Neighbors' in red, '(NN) Equal Distance' in blue. Captions under plots are bold red, smaller than title. Slide number is small black text inside yellow circle.
animation_state: Appears fully built; both panels and all connector lines/highlights are visible.
